commands.name: desk-search
commands.summary: Use when you cannot tell which file holds something, or what changed in a time window. Exact-word search across the desk. Filters: track, status, kind, since, until. `scope`: 'active' (default), 'archived' or 'all'. With no `query`, or `newest: true`, it lists documents by when they were updated, newest first, inside the since/until window (`scope` then defaults to 'all').

query.description: The search query. Omit it to list documents by update time.

newest.description: Pass true to order by update time, newest first, instead of by match.

scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

filters.description: Filters, as a JSON object (not a string), as JSON.

commands.name: desk-recall
commands.summary: Use for loose recall, as in `do I remember anything about X`. Ranks every desk Markdown file by meaning and exact words together. `scope`: 'active', 'archived' or 'all' (default; this is the historical lookback).

scope.description: Which documents to search: live work, archived work, or both.

commands.name: desk-skill
commands.summary: Use when your client cannot load Desk's skills itself (claude.ai, ChatGPT): read one of Desk's skills, the working procedures its instructions point to. With no `name`, lists every skill with its description; with `name`, returns that skill's text to follow. Read-only and needs no desk.

name.description: The skill to read, such as task-lifecycle; omit it to list every skill.
